comment.narrative: The baseline and endline questionnarie had two questions which combined fruit and vegetables. The food consumption score needs to have separate answers for fruit and vegetables. At Baseline and Midline IDS calculated the FCS by excluding food type 7 and counting food type 6 as vegetables. At Endline FCS was recalculated excluding food type 6 and assuming food type 7 was all vegetables. This was the calculation provided for the logframe. A calculation with an alternative method has been provided in the synthesis including food types 6 and 7 as vegetables. This alternative method gives higher FCS of 61 but may still underestimate as families can only reach a maximum score of 7 out of 14 for fruit and vegetables.
